n = int(input())
mod = int(input())

def calculate(n, mod):
    invs = []
    invs.append([1])
    for i in range(1, n):
        prevInv = invs[i - 1]
        currInv = [0] * (i * (i + 1) // 2 + 1)
        for j in range(len(currInv)):
            sum_val = 0
            for k in range(min(j, i), -1, -1):
                if j - k < len(prevInv):
                    sum_val += prevInv[j - k]
                    sum_val %= mod
            currInv[j] = sum_val
        invs.append(currInv)

    perms = [0] * n
    perms[0] = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        c = (perms[i - 1] * (i + 1)) % mod
        invArr = invs[i - 1]
        for j in range(len(invArr)):
            for k in range(j + 2, len(invArr)):
                mVal = min(k - j, i + 1)
                addVal = ((invArr[j] * invArr[k]) % mod) * ((mVal - 1) * (2 * i - (mVal - 2)) // 2)
                c = (c + addVal) % mod
        perms[i] = c
    print(perms[n - 1])

calculate(n, mod)
